title: River Country

draws.name: The Stilt Refinery
draws.make_up: A Droid-Factory-class fuel refinery on stilts in the west oxbow lake (about 350 x 250 m), with pier causeways
draws.story_reason: Fuel for the whole CIS river fleet; its flares are seen from the river mouth

draws.name: The Headwater Foundry
draws.make_up: A Droid-Factory-class foundry on the east terrace; the planet's ONE capstone interior is inside
draws.story_reason: Builds the droids that hold the river; the end of the run

draws.name: Rodian River City
draws.make_up: A hand-made tiered Rodian town on the levee bend (town work, not a comp) + library checkpoints and AA
draws.story_reason: The river's capital, with the main vehicle bridge

draws.name: The River Weir
draws.make_up: CIS Fortress Dam as a weir across the river + lock house + bunkers
draws.story_reason: Holds the upper river's level; its crest road is an AI crossing

draws.name: The North Bluff Fort
draws.make_up: CIS Small Citadel + artillery + AA on the north bluff edge
draws.story_reason: Its guns see the whole floodplain

draws.name: The South Bluff Quarry
draws.make_up: CIS Mining Complex + artillery on the south bluff
draws.story_reason: Cuts the stone for the foundry; fills the south-east of the map
